_doc: Split recipe for agents/harness-optimizer.md (dormant repo agent). Capability inventory: Read, Grep, Glob, Bash, Edit RETAINED via the writer carrier; Write is ADDED by the class (writer is the only class with Edit; a spec never names tools). Owner chose writer class 2026-10-01 (option a). Write surfaces are harness config only -- never product code, which the role's own Mission forbids. Kill switch is real: the resolver's default grant is verifier, so this spec is unresolvable unless a caller passes --max-class writer. Prompt Defense Baseline moved to the shared primitive, byte-identical. Output format RETAINED in the role page (output_contract native).

contract.name: Agent harness configuration optimizer
contract.sovereign_question: Which minimal, reversible harness change most raises agent completion quality?
contract.rollback: every applied change is reported with its file and diff; restore with `git -C <repo> checkout -- <file>` (uncommitted) or `git revert <sha>` (committed)
contract.kill_switch: omit the writer grant: agent_resolver.resolve defaults to max_class=verifier, which excludes this spec with CLASS_EXCEEDS_GRANT
contract.retirement_condition: a harness-audit command applies the same changes deterministically

agent.description: Analyzes and improves the local agent harness configuration for reliability, cost and throughput.
